citation: M. Arlitt and T. Jin, "1998 World Cup Web Site Access Logs", August 1998. https://ita.ee.lbl.gov/html/contrib/WorldCup.html
hurst_note: hurst_native is reported for the source 1-second series. No post-plateau Hurst value is published. The 36-plateau representation has too few points for an R/S estimate (minimum 64), and a hold-resampled version measures the resampling rather than the traffic. The plateau representation destroys all sub-30s structure by construction, so the shapes we run are not self-similar at fine timescales regardless of the source. This is a property of the representation, not of the traces.
